# Ridhi Jain — Metabolic Reset Method™ (RJ Fitness)

> Online fat-loss and nutrition coaching for working women in India by Ridhi Jain (@coachridhijain, Instagram). Specialises in PCOS, thyroid, postpartum and hormone-friendly weight loss using Indian (desi) food and 30-minute home workouts.

## What the program is
- The Metabolic Reset Method™: a hormone-friendly fat-loss system built on four pillars — a personalised Indian-food meal plan, 30-minute home workouts, a hormone and sleep reset, and 1:1 accountability.
- Typical outcome communicated on the site: 8–10 kg in 12 weeks without crash diets, no gym required.
- Every client starts with a free 20-minute strategy call.

## Coaching plans (pricing shared on WhatsApp — one-time fee, no subscription)
Guided plans are built and executed by the Head Nutritionist, with strategy and progress overseen by Ridhi Jain.
- Guided 30 Days: custom nutrition and training plan, 1 intro call and 1 monthly call with Ridhi, 2 calls with the Head Nutritionist, weekly check-ins, recipe book.
- Guided 60 Days: everything in 30 days plus 8 calls with the Head Nutritionist and more accountability. Best starting point.
- Guided 90 Days: everything in 60 days plus blood-work analysis, supplement guidance, 2 recipe books, 3 calls with Ridhi, unlimited WhatsApp support. Most economical.
- Guided 6 Months: everything in 90 days plus 6 calls with Ridhi and full strategy revisions by Ridhi for 6 months.

Elite plans are built and coached by Ridhi Jain personally.
- Elite 3 Months: plan built by Ridhi, 1 long strategy call, weekly calls with Ridhi, daily accountability with the Head Coach, weekly 1:1 WhatsApp with Ridhi, unlimited WhatsApp support.
- Elite 6 Months: everything in Elite 3 Months for a full 6 months of coaching and adjustments.

Prices are not published on the website. Every enquiry goes to the team on WhatsApp, who share the fee for the recommended plan after a free strategy call. There is no online checkout on the site.
